text: Hey folks, quick question—if I need to take a sick day for a doctor's appointment, do I just mark it as 'Out Sick' in Workday? Or is there something else I need to do?

Yep, just mark it as 'Out Sick' in Workday so it gets tracked properly. That covers both illness and medical appointments. If it’s just a regular sick day or appointment, you don’t need to email anyone unless you’re out for a longer stretch. If you’re out for more than 5 days, there’s a different process—think you have to loop in the Absence Management team (leaves@domain.com) and maybe provide a doctor’s note, depending on the province. It’s all in the handbook under the sick leave section if you want the details!
Awesome, thanks Yuki! Just wanted to make sure I wasn’t missing a step. I’ll check the handbook if I end up needing more time.
